AI Model Market Daily: Reading AI Models Like a Stock Market Board

Community Article Published
November 27, 2026 Upvote 7 VIDRAFT_LAB SeaWolf-AI FINAL-Bench
Live board: AI Model Market Daily · Daily data: VIDraft/ai-model-market-daily

Short answer

AI Model Market Daily is a daily board that tracks AI models the way a stock screen tracks companies: on three axes at once, money, intelligence and security. Every morning it rebuilds a composite ranking called AMM 100 from Hugging Face official benchmark boards, SuperCLUE, LMArena, download and trending data, token sales on OpenRouter, and security scans, and publishes the full snapshot as an open dataset.
On 27 November 2026 the board tracked 885 models, ranked 211 open-weight models that appear on at least two of the 63 official Hugging Face benchmark boards, and scanned 538 models for supply-chain hygiene.

Why one axis is not enough

A single leaderboard answers a single question. Teams choosing a model ask three.

Axis
The question
What the board reads

Money
Is anyone actually paying to use it?
Tokens per model on OpenRouter over the trailing 7 days

Intelligence
How good is it, compared fairly?
Hugging Face official boards, SuperCLUE, LMArena

Security
Is it safe to bring in and to let act?
Supply-chain scans, attack resistance, agent safety

On 27 November the three axes had three different leaders: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 led token sales with 73.7T tokens in 7 days (38.3% share), Gemini 4 Argon led intelligence at 70.2, and Kimi K3.1 Pro led agent safety at 98.6. No single leaderboard shows that picture.

Two rankings, because "open" and "frontier" are different questions

AMM 100 SOTA: closed and open together

A frontier ranking has to include closed models, and Hugging Face boards list almost only open-weight ones. So the SOTA board uses sources that cover both.

Base scale: SuperCLUE total
LMArena percentiles (overall, coding, hard prompts, expert, math) are placed on that scale by mean-sigma linking on shared models (11 anchor models)
Score = mean of the available sources

Top five on 27 November: Gemini 4 Argon 70.2, Gemini 4 Carbon 67.3, Gemini 4 Neon 66.4, Claude Fable 5 65.9, GPT-6.1 Sol 65.7.

AMM 100 Open: models you can actually download

"Open" means the weights can be downloaded on Hugging Face from the developer's own organization. The board checks the repository file list. A licence string or a leaderboard's "open" label alone does not count. On this rule, 203 of 218 models labelled open were verified, and 3 open models that were not labelled as open were found.

Part
Weight
How it is computed

Performance P
0.50
Per official board, the percentile of the model's value-based rank (ties share a rank). P = mean percentile × √(min(N,10)/10), where N is the number of boards entered, so one lucky board cannot carry a model

Wins T
0.15
T = 100 × min(1, √((wins + 0.25 × 2nd/3rd places) / 10)) over official boards and SuperCLUE axes

Popularity Q
0.35
Mean percentile of 30-day ecosystem downloads (original plus quantized and adapter derivatives), likes and trending score

AMM 100 Open = 0.50 × P + 0.15 × T + 0.35 × Q. Top five on 27 November: Kimi-K3.1-Pro 77.3, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 76.8, Inkling-2-Small 73.7, Kimi-K3 73.2, GLM-5.2 71.1.
Of the open-weight top 100, 70 came from China, 21 from the United States, 5 from Korea, 2 from France and 2 from elsewhere.

Security, in layers shown side by side

Security is not one number, so the board shows three layers next to each other instead of blending them.

Layer
What it checks
27 November

L1 Supply-chain hygiene (every model)
Hugging Face malware and pickle scans, weight file format, remote code, licence and provenance
Top 300 by downloads: grade A 193, B 92, C 15, D 0, F 0. 21 ship pickle files, 35 ship custom remote code

L2 Attack resistance
ViKernel Scanner: six attack domains on models given mock tools
21 open models scanned. Average attack success 16.7%, and 0.0% with the ViKernel gate in front

L3 Agent safety
Agent Safety Leaderboard
19 models measured, #1 Kimi K3.1 Pro 98.6

A scan that did not finish is counted as "not completed", never as a detection.

Popularity, measured every day

The Downloads 300 and Trending 300 tables are re-read every morning, with one-day movement and the L1 security grade next to each model. On 27 November the top 300 models together had 509.8 million downloads over 30 days.

Rules that keep the board honest

Ranked by value only. No model is placed by hand.
Sources that forbid it are not used. Artificial Analysis (terms forbid a competing site) and OpenCompass (non-commercial clause) are not used without written permission.
Every snapshot is public. Each day's market.json and registry.json are in the dataset, so any number on the board can be traced back.
The interface follows the reader. Korean, English, Chinese or Japanese by browser language, light or dark by system setting.

How to use it

Open the board and read the three cards at the top: today's money, intelligence and security leaders
Use Find your model to filter by use, deployment, size, security grade, price and country
Switch between AMM 100 SOTA and AMM 100 Open to see the frontier and the downloadable field separately
Open Security before you bring a model in, and Method to see every formula

FAQ

What is AMM 100?

A composite ranking of AI models rebuilt every day. The Open version combines official benchmark performance, wins and real-world popularity. The SOTA version compares closed and open frontier models on SuperCLUE and LMArena.

Why are there two rankings?

Hugging Face boards cover almost only open-weight models, so a frontier comparison needs sources that include closed models. Mixing the two would rank closed models by missing data.

What counts as an open model?

Only a model whose weights can be downloaded on Hugging Face from the developer's own organization. Licence text or a leaderboard label is not enough.

Where does the data come from?

The Hugging Face API and official benchmark boards, SuperCLUE (credited), LMArena (CC-BY), OpenRouter Rankings, ViKernel Scanner and the Agent Safety Leaderboard, and news headlines with links.

Can I use the data?

Yes. Every daily snapshot is published in the VIDraft/ai-model-market-daily dataset.
